reason: Preserve the observed synthetic portrayal and economic-solicitation mechanism without attributing all losses from a wider fraud category to the specific AI-generated adverts.

old_to_new_clause_crosswalk.old_evidence: Original Swedish investigation describing the campaign, impersonated figures, victim estimate and aggregate loss estimate.
The campaign used synthetic financial-figure endorsements to solicit investment.
The campaign used synthetic endorsements to influence investment choice, while the fraudulent objective was attributed to human scammers.

new_episode_inventory.source_paraphrase: In 2025, scammers used AI-generated videos and false online profiles portraying Swedish financial figures as endorsing investments without their authorisation. Investor Günter Mårder described approximately 30–40 adverts using his likeness, including synthetic footage in professional-looking settings; other financial personalities were also impersonated.

The impostor profiles and fabricated endorsements led viewers from social-media investment tips into investment groups and solicitations. TV4 and Sveriges Radio described the tactic alongside wider 2025 pump-and-dump fraud and reported at least 5,000 victims and about SEK 500 million in losses for the wider fraud activity. The sources do not identify what portion of those aggregate losses arose from the specific AI-generated adverts or portrayals in this record.

Impersonated financial figures learned of the adverts through questions from members of the public. Mårder described time spent during the summer responding to enquiries, injury to professional reputation and difficulty maintaining trust in online investment information. The published interviews do not quantify loss to each impersonated individual.

material_new_evidence: A third episode captures the direct affected-party report of reputational and response burden.
harm_disposition: Financial-economic S3 -> unreported because the published SEK 500m estimate covers a wider fraud category, not quantifiable loss attributable to this bounded AI impersonation. Reputation/dignity S3 and overall S3 remain.
